youtube.title: Good Morning Bible Verse | Isaiah 26:3 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Mind racing already? Hear this.

"Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee." Isaiah 26:3 (KJV)

Peace isn't the absence of problems. It's keeping your mind on him while you've got them.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
